---
title: "Module 04: Single-cell RNA-seq cell-type annotation with SingleR"
output: html_document
date: "2026-08-06"
---

```{r}

#==============================================================================
# MODULE 04 — SingleR cell-type annotation and marker validation
#==============================================================================

# Purpose:
#   Annotate the processed GSE298688 single-cell RNA-seq dataset using the
#   celldex MouseRNAseqData reference and SingleR. Perform broad and fine
#   cell-level annotation, cluster-level annotation, map predictions back to
#   Seurat metadata, compare annotations with unsupervised Seurat clusters,
#   perform differential expression between broad SingleR cell types,
#   validate major lineages using canonical marker genes, generate diagnostic
#   figures and tables, and save the annotated single-cell reference for
#   downstream CellChat, spatial annotation, and CARD deconvolution.
#
# Input:
#   data/processed/single_cell/
#     GSE298688_processed_clustered_seurat.rds
#
# Primary output object:
#   data/processed/single_cell/
#     GSE298688_SingleR_annotated_seurat.rds
#
# SingleR prediction objects:
#   data/processed/single_cell/singleR/
#     GSE298688_SingleR_cell_level_broad_predictions.rds
#     GSE298688_SingleR_cell_level_fine_predictions.rds
#     GSE298688_SingleR_cluster_level_predictions.rds
#
# Output tables:
#   results/single_cell/singleR/
#   results/single_cell/singleR/cell_type_markers/
#
# Output figures:
#   figures/single_cell/singleR/
#   figures/single_cell/singleR/diagnostics/
#   figures/single_cell/singleR/cell_type_markers/
#   figures/single_cell/singleR/cell_type_markers/volcano_plots/
#
# Annotation strategy:
#   Reference:           celldex MouseRNAseqData
#   Broad labels:        label.main
#   Fine labels:         label.fine
#   Cell-level SingleR:  broad + fine
#   Cluster SingleR:     broad
#   Fine tuning:         TRUE
#   Pruning:             TRUE
#
# Cell-type differential expression:
#   Identity:            SingleR_broad_pruned
#   Test:                Wilcoxon rank-sum test
#   Minimum percentage:  0.10
#   log2FC threshold:    0.25
#   Adjusted P threshold used for visualization: 0.05
#
# Notes:
#   - "Unassigned" cells represent predictions removed by SingleR pruning.
#   - Unassigned cells remain in the annotated reference object but are
#     excluded from cell-type marker discovery.
#   - Automated SingleR labels should be interpreted together with canonical
#     markers, cluster-level marker genes, and biological context.
#   - Cell-type DEA performed here is distinct from treatment-level DEA.
#==============================================================================


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load required packages
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(SingleCellExperiment)
  library(SingleR)
  library(celldex)
  library(SummarizedExperiment)
  library(BiocParallel)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(here)
})


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Reproducibility settings
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(1234)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Define analysis parameters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

singleR_fine_tune <- TRUE

singleR_prune <- TRUE

minimum_shared_genes <- 1000

marker_min_pct <- 0.10

marker_log2fc_threshold <- 0.25

adjusted_p_threshold <- 0.05

top_markers_per_cell_type <- 10


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Define repository paths
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

processed_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "single_cell"
)


singleR_object_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "single_cell",
  "singleR"
)


singleR_results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "single_cell",
  "singleR"
)


celltype_marker_results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "single_cell",
  "singleR",
  "cell_type_markers"
)


singleR_figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "single_cell",
  "singleR"
)


diagnostic_figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "single_cell",
  "singleR",
  "diagnostics"
)


celltype_marker_figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "single_cell",
  "singleR",
  "cell_type_markers"
)


celltype_volcano_figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "single_cell",
  "singleR",
  "cell_type_markers",
  "volcano_plots"
)


directories_to_create <- c(
  processed_directory,
  singleR_object_directory,
  singleR_results_directory,
  celltype_marker_results_directory,
  singleR_figure_directory,
  diagnostic_figure_directory,
  celltype_marker_figure_directory,
  celltype_volcano_figure_directory
)


for (directory in directories_to_create) {

  dir.create(
    directory,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
}


input_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "GSE298688_processed_clustered_seurat.rds"
)


annotated_object_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_annotated_seurat.rds"
)


broad_prediction_file <- file.path(
  singleR_object_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_cell_level_broad_predictions.rds"
)


fine_prediction_file <- file.path(
  singleR_object_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_cell_level_fine_predictions.rds"
)


cluster_prediction_file <- file.path(
  singleR_object_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_cluster_level_predictions.rds"
)


cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "MODULE 04 — SingleR cell-type annotation\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "Repository root:       ", here::here(), "\n",
  "Input object:          ", input_file, "\n",
  "Processed data:        ", processed_directory, "\n",
  "SingleR objects:       ", singleR_object_directory, "\n",
  "SingleR results:       ", singleR_results_directory, "\n",
  "SingleR figures:       ", singleR_figure_directory, "\n",
  "============================================================\n\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Validate and load Module 03 output
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!file.exists(input_file)) {

  stop(
    "Module 03 output was not found:\n",
    input_file,
    "\n\nRun 03_seurat_normalization_n_dea.Rmd before Module 04."
  )
}


cat(
  "Loading processed single-cell Seurat object...\n"
)


single_cell <- readRDS(
  input_file
)


if (!inherits(
  single_cell,
  "Seurat"
)) {

  stop(
    "Loaded input file is not a valid Seurat object."
  )
}


if (!"RNA" %in% Seurat::Assays(
  single_cell
)) {

  stop(
    "RNA assay was not found in the input Seurat object."
  )
}


Seurat::DefaultAssay(
  single_cell
) <- "RNA"


required_metadata <- c(
  "sample",
  "condition",
  "seurat_clusters"
)


missing_metadata <- setdiff(
  required_metadata,
  colnames(
    single_cell@meta.data
  )
)


if (length(
  missing_metadata
) > 0) {

  stop(
    "Required metadata column(s) missing from input object:\n",
    paste(
      missing_metadata,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}


if (!"umap" %in% names(
  single_cell@reductions
)) {

  stop(
    "UMAP reduction was not found. Run Module 03 before SingleR annotation."
  )
}


cat(
  "Object loaded successfully:\n",
  "  Genes:    ", nrow(single_cell), "\n",
  "  Cells:    ", ncol(single_cell), "\n",
  "  Samples:  ",
  length(
    unique(
      single_cell$sample
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  "  Clusters: ",
  length(
    unique(
      single_cell$seurat_clusters
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Inspect and validate normalized RNA expression
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Inspecting normalized RNA expression\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


rna_layers <- SeuratObject::Layers(
  single_cell[["RNA"]]
)


cat(
  "RNA assay layers:\n"
)


print(
  rna_layers
)


if (
  sum(
    grepl(
      "^data",
      rna_layers
    )
  ) > 1
) {

  cat(
    "\nMultiple normalized RNA data layers detected.\n",
    "Joining RNA layers before SingleR annotation...\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  single_cell <- SeuratObject::JoinLayers(
    single_cell,
    assay = "RNA"
  )
}


if (!"data" %in% SeuratObject::Layers(
  single_cell[["RNA"]]
)) {

  stop(
    paste(
      "Normalized RNA data layer was not found.",
      "Run NormalizeData() in Module 03 before SingleR annotation."
    )
  )
}


normalized_expression <- Seurat::GetAssayData(
  object = single_cell,
  assay = "RNA",
  layer = "data"
)


if (
  nrow(
    normalized_expression
  ) == 0 ||
  ncol(
    normalized_expression
  ) == 0
) {

  stop(
    "Normalized RNA expression matrix is empty."
  )
}


cat(
  "Normalized RNA expression detected:\n",
  "  Genes: ", nrow(normalized_expression), "\n",
  "  Cells: ", ncol(normalized_expression), "\n",
  sep = ""
)


rm(
  normalized_expression
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Confirm mouse-style gene symbols
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

mouse_marker_check <- c(
  "Cd3d",
  "P2ry12",
  "Csf1r",
  "Aif1",
  "Gfap"
)


human_marker_check <- c(
  "CD3D",
  "P2RY12",
  "CSF1R",
  "AIF1",
  "GFAP"
)


mouse_markers_detected <- intersect(
  mouse_marker_check,
  rownames(
    single_cell
  )
)


human_markers_detected <- intersect(
  human_marker_check,
  rownames(
    single_cell
  )
)


cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Gene-symbol species check\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Mouse-style markers detected: ",
  paste(
    mouse_markers_detected,
    collapse = ", "
  ),
  "\n",
  "Human-style markers detected: ",
  paste(
    human_markers_detected,
    collapse = ", "
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


if (
  length(
    mouse_markers_detected
  ) == 0
) {

  warning(
    paste(
      "No expected mouse-style marker symbols were detected.",
      "Confirm species and gene-symbol format before interpreting SingleR."
    )
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Load celldex MouseRNAseqData reference
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Loading celldex MouseRNAseqData reference\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


mouse_reference <- celldex::MouseRNAseqData()


if (
  nrow(
    mouse_reference
  ) == 0 ||
  ncol(
    mouse_reference
  ) == 0
) {

  stop(
    "MouseRNAseqData reference was empty."
  )
}


if (
  !"label.main" %in% colnames(
    SummarizedExperiment::colData(
      mouse_reference
    )
  ) ||
  !"label.fine" %in% colnames(
    SummarizedExperiment::colData(
      mouse_reference
    )
  )
) {

  stop(
    "Expected label.main or label.fine metadata was not found in reference."
  )
}


cat(
  "Reference loaded successfully:\n",
  "  Reference samples: ", ncol(mouse_reference), "\n",
  "  Reference genes:   ", nrow(mouse_reference), "\n",
  "  Broad cell types:  ",
  length(
    unique(
      mouse_reference$label.main
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  "  Fine cell types:   ",
  length(
    unique(
      mouse_reference$label.fine
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Convert Seurat object to SingleCellExperiment
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Converting Seurat object to SingleCellExperiment\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


single_cell_sce <- Seurat::as.SingleCellExperiment(
  x = single_cell,
  assay = "RNA"
)


sce_assays <- SummarizedExperiment::assayNames(
  single_cell_sce
)


cat(
  "SingleCellExperiment assays:\n"
)


print(
  sce_assays
)


if (!"logcounts" %in% sce_assays) {

  stop(
    paste(
      "The converted SingleCellExperiment does not contain a",
      "'logcounts' assay required for SingleR."
    )
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Examine query-reference gene overlap
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

shared_genes <- intersect(
  rownames(
    single_cell_sce
  ),
  rownames(
    mouse_reference
  )
)


gene_overlap_percent <- 100 *
  length(
    shared_genes
  ) /
  nrow(
    single_cell_sce
  )


cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Query-reference gene overlap\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Shared genes: ",
  length(
    shared_genes
  ),
  "\n",
  "Query genes represented in reference: ",
  round(
    gene_overlap_percent,
    1
  ),
  "%\n",
  sep = ""
)


if (
  length(
    shared_genes
  ) < minimum_shared_genes
) {

  warning(
    paste(
      "Fewer than",
      minimum_shared_genes,
      "genes overlap between query and reference.",
      "Check species and gene identifiers."
    )
  )
}


gene_overlap_table <- data.frame(
  query_genes = nrow(
    single_cell_sce
  ),
  reference_genes = nrow(
    mouse_reference
  ),
  shared_genes = length(
    shared_genes
  ),
  query_overlap_percent = gene_overlap_percent
)


gene_overlap_file <- file.path(
  singleR_results_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_query_reference_gene_overlap.csv"
)


utils::write.csv(
  gene_overlap_table,
  gene_overlap_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Run broad cell-level SingleR annotation
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Running broad cell-level SingleR annotation\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


singleR_broad <- SingleR::SingleR(
  test = single_cell_sce,
  ref = mouse_reference,
  labels = mouse_reference$label.main,
  assay.type.test = "logcounts",
  assay.type.ref = "logcounts",
  fine.tune = singleR_fine_tune,
  prune = singleR_prune,
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam()
)


cat(
  "Broad cell-level SingleR annotation completed successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Run fine cell-level SingleR annotation
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Running fine cell-level SingleR annotation\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


singleR_fine <- SingleR::SingleR(
  test = single_cell_sce,
  ref = mouse_reference,
  labels = mouse_reference$label.fine,
  assay.type.test = "logcounts",
  assay.type.ref = "logcounts",
  fine.tune = singleR_fine_tune,
  prune = singleR_prune,
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam()
)


cat(
  "Fine cell-level SingleR annotation completed successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13. Validate SingleR prediction barcodes
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (
  !setequal(
    rownames(
      singleR_broad
    ),
    colnames(
      single_cell
    )
  )
) {

  stop(
    "Broad SingleR prediction barcodes do not match Seurat cell barcodes."
  )
}


if (
  !setequal(
    rownames(
      singleR_fine
    ),
    colnames(
      single_cell
    )
  )
) {

  stop(
    "Fine SingleR prediction barcodes do not match Seurat cell barcodes."
  )
}


singleR_broad <- singleR_broad[
  colnames(
    single_cell
  ),
]


singleR_fine <- singleR_fine[
  colnames(
    single_cell
  ),
]


if (
  !identical(
    rownames(
      singleR_broad
    ),
    colnames(
      single_cell
    )
  ) ||
  !identical(
    rownames(
      singleR_fine
    ),
    colnames(
      single_cell
    )
  )
) {

  stop(
    "SingleR predictions could not be reordered to match Seurat cell order."
  )
}


cat(
  "SingleR prediction barcodes match Seurat cells exactly.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 14. Add cell-level SingleR predictions to Seurat metadata
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

singleR_metadata <- data.frame(

  SingleR_broad_label =
    singleR_broad$labels,

  SingleR_broad_pruned =
    singleR_broad$pruned.labels,

  SingleR_broad_delta =
    singleR_broad$delta.next,

  SingleR_fine_label =
    singleR_fine$labels,

  SingleR_fine_pruned =
    singleR_fine$pruned.labels,

  SingleR_fine_delta =
    singleR_fine$delta.next,

  row.names = colnames(
    single_cell
  ),

  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


singleR_metadata$SingleR_broad_pruned[
  is.na(
    singleR_metadata$SingleR_broad_pruned
  )
] <- "Unassigned"


singleR_metadata$SingleR_fine_pruned[
  is.na(
    singleR_metadata$SingleR_fine_pruned
  )
] <- "Unassigned"


single_cell <- Seurat::AddMetaData(
  object = single_cell,
  metadata = singleR_metadata
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 15. Summarize cell-level annotations
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Broad SingleR annotation summary\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


print(
  table(
    single_cell$SingleR_broad_pruned,
    useNA = "ifany"
  )
)


cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Fine SingleR annotation summary\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


print(
  table(
    single_cell$SingleR_fine_pruned,
    useNA = "ifany"
  )
)


broad_unassigned_percent <- mean(
  single_cell$SingleR_broad_pruned ==
    "Unassigned"
) * 100


fine_unassigned_percent <- mean(
  single_cell$SingleR_fine_pruned ==
    "Unassigned"
) * 100


cat(
  "\nUnassigned cells after pruning:\n",
  "  Broad annotation: ",
  round(
    broad_unassigned_percent,
    2
  ),
  "%\n",
  "  Fine annotation:  ",
  round(
    fine_unassigned_percent,
    2
  ),
  "%\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 16. Create cell-level SingleR UMAP plots
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

singleR_broad_umap <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  object = single_cell,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "SingleR_broad_pruned",
  label = TRUE,
  repel = TRUE,
  label.size = 3
) +
  ggplot2::ggtitle(
    "SingleR Broad Cell-Type Annotation"
  )


singleR_fine_umap <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  object = single_cell,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "SingleR_fine_pruned",
  label = TRUE,
  repel = TRUE,
  label.size = 3
) +
  ggplot2::ggtitle(
    "SingleR Fine Cell-Type Annotation"
  )


print(
  singleR_broad_umap
)


print(
  singleR_fine_umap
)


broad_umap_file <- file.path(
  singleR_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_broad_cell_level_UMAP.png"
)


fine_umap_file <- file.path(
  singleR_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_fine_cell_level_UMAP.png"
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = broad_umap_file,
  plot = singleR_broad_umap,
  width = 8,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = fine_umap_file,
  plot = singleR_fine_umap,
  width = 9,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 17. Compare cell-level SingleR predictions with Seurat clusters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

broad_cluster_table <- table(
  Cluster = single_cell$seurat_clusters,
  SingleR = single_cell$SingleR_broad_pruned
)


fine_cluster_table <- table(
  Cluster = single_cell$seurat_clusters,
  SingleR = single_cell$SingleR_fine_pruned
)


broad_cluster_proportions <- prop.table(
  broad_cluster_table,
  margin = 1
)


fine_cluster_proportions <- prop.table(
  fine_cluster_table,
  margin = 1
)


cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Broad annotation by Seurat cluster\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


print(
  broad_cluster_table
)


cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Fine annotation by Seurat cluster\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


print(
  fine_cluster_table
)


broad_cluster_count_file <- file.path(
  singleR_results_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_broad_by_cluster_counts.csv"
)


fine_cluster_count_file <- file.path(
  singleR_results_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_fine_by_cluster_counts.csv"
)


broad_cluster_proportion_file <- file.path(
  singleR_results_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_broad_by_cluster_proportions.csv"
)


fine_cluster_proportion_file <- file.path(
  singleR_results_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_fine_by_cluster_proportions.csv"
)


utils::write.csv(
  as.data.frame.matrix(
    broad_cluster_table
  ),
  broad_cluster_count_file
)


utils::write.csv(
  as.data.frame.matrix(
    fine_cluster_table
  ),
  fine_cluster_count_file
)


utils::write.csv(
  as.data.frame.matrix(
    round(
      broad_cluster_proportions,
      4
    )
  ),
  broad_cluster_proportion_file
)


utils::write.csv(
  as.data.frame.matrix(
    round(
      fine_cluster_proportions,
      4
    )
  ),
  fine_cluster_proportion_file
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 18. Run cluster-level SingleR annotation
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cluster_ids <- as.character(
  single_cell$seurat_clusters
)


names(
  cluster_ids
) <- colnames(
  single_cell
)


cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Running cluster-level SingleR annotation\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


singleR_cluster <- SingleR::SingleR(
  test = single_cell_sce,
  ref = mouse_reference,
  labels = mouse_reference$label.main,
  clusters = cluster_ids,
  assay.type.test = "logcounts",
  assay.type.ref = "logcounts",
  fine.tune = singleR_fine_tune,
  prune = singleR_prune,
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam()
)


cat(
  "Cluster-level SingleR annotation completed successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 19. Map cluster-level predictions back to individual cells
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cluster_label_map <- stats::setNames(
  as.character(
    singleR_cluster$labels
  ),
  rownames(
    singleR_cluster
  )
)


cluster_pruned_map <- stats::setNames(
  as.character(
    singleR_cluster$pruned.labels
  ),
  rownames(
    singleR_cluster
  )
)


cell_cluster_ids <- as.character(
  single_cell$seurat_clusters
)


cell_cluster_labels <- unname(
  cluster_label_map[
    cell_cluster_ids
  ]
)


cell_cluster_pruned <- unname(
  cluster_pruned_map[
    cell_cluster_ids
  ]
)


if (
  length(
    cell_cluster_labels
  ) != ncol(
    single_cell
  ) ||
  length(
    cell_cluster_pruned
  ) != ncol(
    single_cell
  )
) {

  stop(
    "Cluster-level SingleR predictions could not be mapped to all cells."
  )
}


cell_cluster_pruned[
  is.na(
    cell_cluster_pruned
  )
] <- "Unassigned"


single_cell$SingleR_cluster_label <-
  cell_cluster_labels


single_cell$SingleR_cluster_pruned <-
  cell_cluster_pruned


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 20. Save cluster-level annotation summary
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cluster_annotation_summary <- data.frame(
  cluster = rownames(

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 29. Prepare confidently annotated cells for cell-type DEA
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "SingleR broad cell-type differential expression\n",
  "============================================================\n"
)


annotation_column <- "SingleR_broad_pruned"


if (!annotation_column %in% colnames(
  single_cell@meta.data
)) {

  stop(
    "SingleR annotation column was not found: ",
    annotation_column
  )
}


single_cell_de <- subset(
  single_cell,
  subset = SingleR_broad_pruned != "Unassigned"
)


if (
  ncol(
    single_cell_de
  ) == 0
) {

  stop(
    "No confidently annotated cells remained for cell-type DEA."
  )
}


cat(
  "Cells included in cell-type DEA: ",
  ncol(
    single_cell_de
  ),
  "\n",
  "Unassigned cells excluded: ",
  ncol(
    single_cell
  ) -
    ncol(
      single_cell_de
    ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


Seurat::DefaultAssay(
  single_cell_de
) <- "RNA"


Seurat::Idents(
  single_cell_de
) <- annotation_column


cell_type_counts <- table(
  Seurat::Idents(
    single_cell_de
  )
)


cat(
  "\nCell counts by SingleR broad cell type:\n"
)


print(
  cell_type_counts
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 30. Confirm RNA layers are joined before cell-type DEA
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

rna_layers_dea <- SeuratObject::Layers(
  single_cell_de[["RNA"]]
)


if (
  sum(
    grepl(
      "^data",
      rna_layers_dea
    )
  ) > 1
) {

  single_cell_de <- SeuratObject::JoinLayers(
    single_cell_de,
    assay = "RNA"
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 31. Identify differentially expressed genes by SingleR cell type
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Running FindAllMarkers() by SingleR broad cell type\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


singleR_celltype_markers <- Seurat::FindAllMarkers(
  object = single_cell_de,
  assay = "RNA",
  only.pos = FALSE,
  min.pct = marker_min_pct,
  logfc.threshold = marker_log2fc_threshold,
  test.use = "wilcox",
  verbose = FALSE
)


if (
  nrow(
    singleR_celltype_markers
  ) == 0
) {

  stop(
    "No SingleR cell-type marker genes were identified."
  )
}


if (!"gene" %in% colnames(
  singleR_celltype_markers
)) {

  singleR_celltype_markers$gene <- rownames(
    singleR_celltype_markers
  )
}


cat(
  "Cell-type differential expression completed successfully.\n",
  "Marker results identified: ",
  nrow(
    singleR_celltype_markers
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 32. Save complete cell-type differential-expression results
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

celltype_marker_file <- file.path(
  celltype_marker_results_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_broad_cell_type_markers_all.csv"
)


utils::write.csv(
  singleR_celltype_markers,
  celltype_marker_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 33. Summarize marker genes by SingleR cell type
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

singleR_marker_summary <- singleR_celltype_markers %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    cluster
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(

    total_markers = dplyr::n(),

    positive_markers = sum(
      avg_log2FC > 0 &
        p_val_adj < adjusted_p_threshold,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    negative_markers = sum(
      avg_log2FC < 0 &
        p_val_adj < adjusted_p_threshold,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


colnames(
  singleR_marker_summary
)[
  colnames(
    singleR_marker_summary
  ) == "cluster"
] <- "cell_type"


cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Marker summary by SingleR cell type\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


print(
  singleR_marker_summary
)


celltype_marker_summary_file <- file.path(
  celltype_marker_results_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_broad_cell_type_marker_summary.csv"
)


utils::write.csv(
  singleR_marker_summary,
  celltype_marker_summary_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 34. Select top positive markers for each cell type
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

singleR_top_markers <- singleR_celltype_markers %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(
      p_val_adj
    ),
    p_val_adj < adjusted_p_threshold,
    avg_log2FC > 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    cluster
  ) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(
    order_by = avg_log2FC,
    n = top_markers_per_cell_type,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()


if (
  nrow(
    singleR_top_markers
  ) == 0
) {

  stop(
    "No significant positive SingleR cell-type markers were available."
  )
}

  celltype_marker_results_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_broad_top10_cell_type_markers.csv"
)


utils::write.csv(
  singleR_top_markers,
  singleR_top_marker_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


cat(
  "\nTop marker genes selected for ",
  length(
    unique(
      singleR_top_markers$cluster
    )
  ),
  " SingleR cell types.\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 35. Scale selected marker genes for heatmap visualization
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

celltype_heatmap_genes <- unique(
  singleR_top_markers$gene
)


celltype_heatmap_genes <- intersect(
  celltype_heatmap_genes,
  rownames(
    single_cell_de
  )
)


if (
  length(
    celltype_heatmap_genes
  ) == 0
) {

  stop(
    "No selected SingleR marker genes were found in the Seurat object."
  )
}


single_cell_de <- Seurat::ScaleData(
  single_cell_de,
  assay = "RNA",
  features = celltype_heatmap_genes,
  verbose = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 36. Generate SingleR cell-type marker heatmap
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

singleR_celltype_heatmap <- Seurat::DoHeatmap(
  single_cell_de,
  features = celltype_heatmap_genes,
  group.by = annotation_column,
  size = 3
) +
  Seurat::NoLegend()


print(
  singleR_celltype_heatmap
)


celltype_heatmap_file <- file.path(
  celltype_marker_figure_directory,
  "GSE298688_SingleR_broad_top10_cell_type_marker_heatmap.png"
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = celltype_heatmap_file,
  plot = singleR_celltype_heatmap,
  width = 14,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 300
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 37. Generate volcano plots for each SingleR cell type
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

singleR_cell_types <- sort(
  unique(
    singleR_celltype_markers$cluster
  )
)


volcano_files <- character(
  length(
    singleR_cell_types
  )
)


for (i in seq_along(
  singleR_cell_types
)) {

  cell_type <- singleR_cell_types[i]


  cell_type_de <- singleR_celltype_markers %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      cluster == cell_type
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(

      significance = dplyr::case_when(

        !is.na(
          p_val_adj
        ) &
          p_val_adj < adjusted_p_threshold &
          avg_log2FC >= marker_log2fc_threshold ~
          "Upregulated",

        !is.na(
          p_val_adj
        ) &
          p_val_adj < adjusted_p_threshold &
          avg_log2FC <= -marker_log2fc_threshold ~
          "Downregulated",

        TRUE ~
          "Not significant"
      ),

      plot_p = dplyr::if_else(
        is.na(
          p_val_adj
        ),
        NA_real_,
        pmax(
          p_val_adj,
          .Machine$double.xmin
        )
      ),

      neg_log10_p = -log10(
        plot_p
      )
    )


  volcano_labels <- cell_type_de %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      significance == "Upregulated"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice_max(
      order_by = avg_log2FC,
      n = top_markers_per_cell_type,
      with_ties = FALSE
    )


  volcano_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    cell_type_de,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = avg_log2FC,
      y = neg_log10_p
    )
  ) +

    ggplot2::geom_point(
      ggplot2::aes(
        color = significance
      ),
      alpha = 0.65,
      size = 1.5
    ) +

    ggplot2::geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(
        -marker_log2fc_threshold,
        marker_log2fc_threshold
      ),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(
        adjusted_p_threshold
      ),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = volcano_labels,
      ggplot2::aes(
        label = gene
      ),
      size = 3.2,
      box.padding = 0.4,
      point.padding = 0.2,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +

    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Upregulated" = "#D73027",
        "Downregulated" = "#4575B4",
        "Not significant" = "grey70"
      )
    ) +

    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0(
        "Differential Expression of ",
        cell_type
      ),
      subtitle = paste(
        "SingleR cell type compared with",
        "all remaining annotated cells"
      ),
      x = "Average log2 fold change",
      y = expression(
        -log[10](
          "adjusted p-value"
        )
      ),
      color = NULL
    ) +

    ggplot2::theme_classic(
      base_size = 12
    ) +

    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 14
      ),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 11,
        color = "grey35"
      ),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        face = "bold"
      ),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.justification = "left"
    )


  print(
    volcano_plot
  )


  safe_cell_type <- gsub(
    "[^A-Za-z0-9]+",
    "_",
    cell_type
  )


  volcano_file <- file.path(
    celltype_volcano_figure_directory,
    paste0(
      "GSE298688_SingleR_",
      safe_cell_type,
      "_volcano.png"
    )
  )


  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = volcano_file,
    plot = volcano_plot,
    width = 7,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )


  volcano_files[i] <- volcano_file
}


cat(
  "\nVolcano plots generated: ",
  length(
    volcano_files
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 39. Validate final annotated Seurat object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Validating SingleR-annotated Seurat object\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


required_singleR_metadata <- c(
  "SingleR_broad_label",
  "SingleR_broad_pruned",
  "SingleR_broad_delta",
  "SingleR_fine_label",
  "SingleR_fine_pruned",
  "SingleR_fine_delta",
  "SingleR_cluster_label",
  "SingleR_cluster_pruned"
)


missing_singleR_metadata <- setdiff(
  required_singleR_metadata,
  colnames(
    single_cell@meta.data
  )
)


if (
  length(
    missing_singleR_metadata
  ) > 0
) {

  stop(
    "Required SingleR metadata column(s) missing:\n",
    paste(
      missing_singleR_metadata,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}


if (
  ncol(
    single_cell
  ) != nrow(
    singleR_broad
  ) ||
  ncol(
    single_cell
  ) != nrow(
    singleR_fine
  )
) {

  stop(
    "Cell-level SingleR prediction count does not match Seurat cell count."
  )
}


if (
  anyDuplicated(
    colnames(
      single_cell
    )
  ) > 0
) {

  stop(
    "Duplicated cell barcodes detected in annotated Seurat object."
  )
}


cat(
  "SingleR-annotated Seurat object validation completed successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 40. Save annotated Seurat object and prediction objects
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Saving SingleR objects\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)


saveRDS(
  object = single_cell,
  file = annotated_object_file,
  compress = TRUE
)


saveRDS(
  object = singleR_broad,
  file = broad_prediction_file,
  compress = TRUE
)


saveRDS(
  object = singleR_fine,
  file = fine_prediction_file,
  compress = TRUE
)


saveRDS(
  object = singleR_cluster,
  file = cluster_prediction_file,
  compress = TRUE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 41. Validate expected Module 04 outputs
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

expected_object_files <- c(
  annotated_object_file,
  broad_prediction_file,
  fine_prediction_file,
  cluster_prediction_file
)


expected_result_files <- c(
  gene_overlap_file,
  broad_cluster_count_file,
  fine_cluster_count_file,
  broad_cluster_proportion_file,
  fine_cluster_proportion_file,
  cluster_annotation_file,
  broad_cell_type_count_file,
  fine_cell_type_count_file,
  broad_cluster_percent_file,
  celltype_marker_file,
  celltype_marker_summary_file,
  singleR_top_marker_file,
  singleR_parameter_file
)


expected_figure_files <- c(
  broad_umap_file,
  fine_umap_file,
  cluster_umap_file,
  annotation_overview_file,
  broad_cell_count_plot_file,
  fine_cell_count_plot_file,
  cluster_cell_type_plot_file,
  cluster_size_plot_file,
  canonical_marker_plot_file,
  celltype_heatmap_file,
  volcano_files
)


missing_object_files <- expected_object_files[
  !file.exists(
    expected_object_files
  )
]


missing_result_files <- expected_result_files[
  !file.exists(
    expected_result_files
  )
]


missing_figure_files <- expected_figure_files[
  !file.exists(
    expected_figure_files
  )
]


if (
  length(
    missing_object_files
  ) > 0
) {

  stop(
    "One or more expected Module 04 object files were not created:\n",
    paste(
      missing_object_files,
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}


if (
  length(
    missing_result_files
  ) > 0
) {

  stop(
    "One or more expected Module 04 result files were not created:\n",
    paste(
      missing_result_files,
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}


if (
  length(
    missing_figure_files
  ) > 0
) {

  stop(
    "One or more expected Module 04 figure files were not created:\n",
    paste(
      missing_figure_files,
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}


cat(
  "All expected Module 04 outputs were created successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 42. Final module summary
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "MODULE 04 COMPLETE — SingleR cell-type annotation\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "Cells annotated:          ", ncol(single_cell), "\n",
  "Seurat clusters:          ",
  length(
    unique(
      single_cell$seurat_clusters
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  "Broad cell types:         ",
  length(
    unique(
      single_cell$SingleR_broad_pruned
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  "Fine cell types:          ",
  length(
    unique(
      single_cell$SingleR_fine_pruned
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  "Shared reference genes:   ",
  length(
    shared_genes
  ),
  "\n",
  "Broad unassigned cells:   ",
  round(
    broad_unassigned_percent,
    2
  ),
  "%\n",
  "Fine unassigned cells:    ",
  round(
    fine_unassigned_percent,
    2
  ),
  "%\n",
  "Cell types in DEA:        ",
  length(
    singleR_cell_types
  ),
  "\n",
  "Cell-type marker results: ",
  nrow(
    singleR_celltype_markers
  ),
  "\n",
  "Volcano plots:            ",
  length(
    volcano_files
  ),
  "\n",
  "\n",
  "Primary output:\n",
  "  ", annotated_object_file, "\n",
  "\n",
  "SingleR prediction objects:\n",
  "  ", singleR_object_directory, "\n",
  "\n",
  "SingleR result tables:\n",
  "  ", singleR_results_directory, "\n",
  "\n",
  "Cell-type marker tables:\n",
  "  ", celltype_marker_results_directory, "\n",
  "\n",
  "SingleR figures:\n",
  "  ", singleR_figure_directory, "\n",
  "\n",
  "Diagnostic figures:\n",
  "  ", diagnostic_figure_directory, "\n",
  "\n",
  "Cell-type marker figures:\n",
  "  ", celltype_marker_figure_directory, "\n",
  "\n",
  "Next module:\n",
  "  05_seurat_cellchat.Rmd\n",
  "============================================================\n\n",
  sep = ""
)
```
